rows.name:
So you're the new leaders of
the Hræsvelgr Mercenaries?

rows.label: tlk43420145_03_msg0002
rows.name:
I hear all sorts of
good things about you.

rows.label: tlk43420145_03_msg0003
rows.name:
I'm glad you're carrying on
Vandham-san's will.

rows.label: tlk43420145_03_msg0004
rows.name:
And you have that Blade
Suzaku too, right? With
those unusual Dual Scythes?

rows.label: tlk43420145_03_msg0005
rows.name:
You feel more and more like
Vandham-san's successor. Keep it up!
